about.description: ANTHROPIC is a private-company perpetual listed on Coinbase International Exchange, tracking Anthropic, margined and cash-settled in USDC. Traders get synthetic price exposure only - no ownership, dividend or voting rights in the underlying. Funding settles every 1h. Up to 5x leverage. Margin is custodied by the exchange rather than self custodied, and access requires exchange onboarding with identity verification.
